#LOH info (predict original methylation status)

```{r}
LOH_bed <- Sys.glob("output/*/wakhan/*_1.0_*/bed_output/loh_regions.bed")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, skip ="chr1", header =F, col.names = c("chr", "loh_start", "loh_end")) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=output/)[^/]+")))

CN_bed <-  Sys.glob("output/*/wakhan/*_1.0_*/bed_output/*copynumbers_segments.bed") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, skip ="chr1", header =F, col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "coverage", "copynumber_state", "haplotype")) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=output/)[^/]+"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-coverage) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = haplotype, values_from = copynumber_state) %>%
  dplyr::rename(haplo_1 = "1", haplo_2 = "2")
  

CN_LOH <- CN_bed %>%
  full_join(LOH_bed, by = join_by("chr"== "chr", "SampleID"== "SampleID", "start" >= "loh_start", "end" <= "loh_end")) %>%
  mutate(loh = if_else(is.na(loh_start), 0, 1),
        cn = haplo_1 + haplo_2) %>%
  dplyr::select(-loh_start, -loh_end)

```

```{r}
DEL_reads <- readRDS("output/total_del_meth.RDS")

DEL_reads %>%
  filter(ID == "d_2241", ref_position != -1, (abs(ref_position -SV_start )<= 2000 | abs(ref_position -SV_end )<= 2000)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ref_position, y = read_id))+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = SV_start, xmax =SV_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf ), fill = alpha("grey", 0.01))+
   geom_point(shape = 22, color = "black", aes(fill = mod))+
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",midpoint = 0.5)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y =element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  facet_wrap(~read_type, nrow = 2)

DEL_change <- DEL_reads %>%
  mutate(shifted_position =case_when(ref_position > SV_start & ref_position < SV_end &read_type == "alt" ~ (ref_position - SV_start)/abs(SV_len)*2000,
                                     ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position- SV_start,
                                     ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position - SV_end + 2000)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID, shifted_position, read_type) %>%
  summarise(mod_avg = mean(mod, na.rm =T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(values_from = mod_avg, names_from = read_type) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(alt), !is.na(ref)) %>%
  mutate(change = if_else(is.na(ref), alt, alt-ref),
         HRD = if_else(SampleID %in% HRR_list, "HRR", "HRD")) 


DEL_change %>%
  group_by(SampleID, HRD) %>%
  summarise(event_n = n_distinct(ID)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SampleID, y = event_n, fill = HRD))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")+
 facet_wrap( ~HRD,scales = "free_x" )+

DEL_change %>%

            sd = sd(change,na.rm =T)) %>%

pvalue  <-DEL_change %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0, !is.na(ref), !is.na(alt)) %>%
  mutate(bin = floor(shifted_position/100) ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID,bin, HRD ) %>%
  mutate(direction = mean(alt) - mean(ref)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID,bin, HRD , direction) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n()>3) %>%
  group_modify(~ broom::tidy(wilcox.test(x = unlist(.x$alt), y = unlist(.x$ref), exact = F, paired = T)), .keep = T)


pvalue %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(direction = if_else(direction >=0, "+", "-"),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("+","-"))) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, bin, HRD) %>%
  mutate(total_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SampleID, bin, HRD, direction) %>%
  summarise(changed = sum(p.value <= 0.05,na.rm = T)/ total_n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(position = if_else(bin <= 0, "L", "R"))  %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = changed, fill = direction))+
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "% w sig change", labels = scales::percent)+
  facet_wrap(~HRD+ SampleID)+
  theme_bw()


pvalue %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(direction = if_else(direction >=0, "+", "-"),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("+","-"))) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, bin, HRD) %>%
  mutate(total_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SampleID, bin, HRD, direction) %>%
  summarise(changed = sum(p.value <= 0.05,na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(position = if_else(bin <= 0, "L", "R"))  %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = changed, fill = direction))+
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "% w sig change")+
  facet_wrap(~HRD+ SampleID)+
  theme_bw()


sig_p <- pvalue %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value <= 0.05 ) %>%
  mutate(change_type = "sig") %>%
  right_join(DEL_change %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0, !is.na(ref), !is.na(alt)) %>%
  mutate(bin = floor(shifted_position/100) ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID,bin, HRD ) %>%
  mutate(direction = mean(alt) - mean(ref)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID,bin, HRD , direction) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n()>3) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, ID,bin, HRD , direction)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
    left_join(DEL_reads %>%
               dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, SV_len) %>%
               distinct())  %>%
  mutate(change_type = if_else(is.na(change_type), "ns", change_type),
         direction = if_else(direction >=0, "+", "-"),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("+","-")))
  

sig_p %>%
  dplyr::filter(bin<=0 | bin >= 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin , y = -SV_len, group = bin))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~change_type+direction)
```

### cn loh

```{r}
DEL_loh <- DEL_reads %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, `#CHROM`, SV_end, SampleID, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(CN_LOH %>%
              dplyr::select(-haplo_1, -haplo_2), by = join_by(`#CHROM` == chr, SV_end >= start, SV_start <= end, SampleID == SampleID)) %>%
  group_by(ID,`#CHROM`, SV_start, SV_end, SampleID, start, end) %>%
  mutate(seg = (max(end, SV_end) - min(start, SV_start) -abs(start - SV_start) - abs(end - SV_end))/abs(SV_len)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ID,`#CHROM`, SV_start, SV_end, SampleID) %>%
  summarise(loh = sum(loh *seg),
            cn = sum(cn* seg)) %>%
  ungroup()

sig_p %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = change_type , fill = loh, group = loh))+
  geom_bar(stat = "count", position = "fill")
  # facet_wrap(~SampleID+HRD)


DEL_change %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  mutate(loh = as.character(round(loh, 0 ))) %>%
  group_by(shifted_position, SampleID, HRD) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(change,na.rm =T),
            sd = sd(change,na.rm =T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0)%>%
  mutate(upper = avg + sd, lower = avg - sd) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = shifted_position, color = loh))+
  geom_point(aes(y = change),  alpha = 0.2, size = 0.3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2)+
   theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~loh, nrow =2)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), name = "alt-ref")


DEL_change %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  mutate(loh = as.character(round(loh, 0 )),
         cn = paste0("CN=", as.character(round(cn, 0))),
         cn = factor(cn, level = paste0("CN=", as.character(seq(0,20))))) %>%
  group_by(shifted_position, SampleID, HRD) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(change,na.rm =T),
            sd = sd(change,na.rm =T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0)%>%
  mutate(upper = avg + sd, lower = avg - sd) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = shifted_position, color = loh))+
  geom_point(aes(y = change),  alpha = 0.2, size = 0.3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2)+
   theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~cn)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), name = "alt-ref")



DEL_change %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  mutate(loh = as.character(round(loh, 0 )),
         cn = paste0("CN=", as.character(round(cn, 0))),
         cn = factor(cn, level = paste0("CN=", as.character(seq(0,20))))) %>%
  group_by(shifted_position, SampleID, HRD) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(change,na.rm =T),
            sd = sd(change,na.rm =T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0)%>%
  mutate(upper = avg + sd, lower = avg - sd,
         shifted_position_dir = if_else(shifted_position <= 0, "U", "D")) %>%
  filter(abs(change)> 0.5) %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_map(~
  ggplot(data = .x, aes(x =change))+
  geom_histogram(aes(fill= shifted_position_dir), alpha = 0.5, position = "identity")+
  facet_wrap(~cn, scales = "free_y")+
  theme_bw(), .keep = T)


library(ggridges)

DEL_change %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  mutate(loh = as.character(round(loh, 0 )),
         cn = paste0("CN=", as.character(round(cn, 0))),
         cn = factor(cn, level = paste0("CN=", as.character(seq(0,20))))) %>%

DEL_change %>%
  left_join(DEL_loh %>%
              dplyr::select(SampleID, ID, loh, cn)) %>%
  mutate(loh = as.character(round(loh, 0 )),
         cn = paste0("CN=", as.character(round(cn, 0))),
         cn = factor(cn, level = paste0("CN=", as.character(seq(0,20))))) %>%
  group_by(shifted_position, SampleID, HRD) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(change,na.rm =T),
            sd = sd(change,na.rm =T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(shifted_position >= 2000 | shifted_position <=0)%>%
  mutate(upper = avg + sd, lower = avg - sd,
         shifted_position_dir = if_else(shifted_position <= 0, "U", "D"),
        shifted_position_dir = factor(shifted_position_dir , level = c("U", "D")) ) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, ID) %>%
  summarise(sig_prop= sum(abs(change) >= 0.75))%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sig_prop ))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)
```

##extract microhomology

```{r}
library(BSgenome)
library(Biostrings)
hg38 <- getBSgenome('BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38')

get_flanking_sequence <- function(indels) {

    if (dim(indels)[1] > 0) {
        five_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38, indels$seqnames, indels$start - 25, indels$start)
        three_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38, indels$seqnames, indels$end + 1, indels$end + 26)
        deleted <- getSeq(hg38, indels$seqnames, indels$start, indels$end )
    } else {
        five_prime_flank <- c()
        three_prime_flank <- c()
        deleted <- c()
    }
    return(cbind(indels, tibble(deleted = as.character(deleted),
                                five_prime_flank = as.character(five_prime_flank), 
                                three_prime_flank = as.character(three_prime_flank))))
}
get_match_length <- function(x, y) { 
  mat <- nucleotideSubstitutionMatrix(match = 1, mismatch = -3, baseOnly = TRUE)
    return(unlist(pairwiseAlignment(x, y, type = "local",
                                    substitutionMatrix = mat,
                                    gapOpening = 5, gapExtension = 5,
                                    scoreOnly = TRUE)))
}

microhomology_summary <- function(indel_table) {
    indel_table <- indel_table %>% filter(
        ! is.na(deleted),
        ! is.na(three_prime_flank),
        ! is.na(five_prime_flank)
    ) 

    print('computing match statistics')

    if (dim(indel_table)[1] > 0) {
        three_prime <- apply(indel_table, 1, function(z) {
            get_match_length(z['deleted'], z['three_prime_flank'])
        })

        five_prime <- apply(indel_table, 1, function(z) {
            get_match_length(rev_char(z['deleted']), rev_char(z['five_prime_flank']))
        })

        max_match <- apply(cbind(three_prime, five_prime), 1, max)

        indel_table$microhomology_length <- max_match
        indel_table$is_microhomology <- max_match > 2
    } else {
        indel_table$microhomology_length <- numeric()
        indel_table$is_microhomology <- logical()
    }

    return(indel_table)
}

rev_char <- function(char) {
    sapply(char, function(a) {
           paste(rev(substring(a,1:nchar(a),1:nchar(a))),collapse="")
    })
}

get_match_length <- function(x, y) { 
    min_length <- min(nchar(x), nchar(y))
    if (min_length == 0) {
        return(0) 
    } else { 
        return(sum(sapply(1:min_length, function(i) {
            substr(x, 1, i) == substr(y, 1, i) 
        })))
    }
}


del <- sv %>%
  filter(SV_type == "DEL", abs(SV_len)< 5000) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = SV_chr, start = SV_start, end = SV_end, ID)


del_seq <- get_flanking_sequence(del) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(deleted, "N"), !str_detect(five_prime_flank, "N"), !str_detect(three_prime_flank, "N"))

indel_flanked <- del_seq %>%
  microhomology_summary()


indel_flanked %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= microhomology_length))+
  geom_bar(stat = "count")


indel_flanked %>%
  filter(microhomology_length>20)


 OVCAR8_diff %>%
   left_join(indel_flanked %>%
     dplyr::select(ID,deleted, five_prime_flank, three_prime_flank, microhomology_length)) %>%
   drop_na() %>%
   filter(abs(relative_pos) <500) %>%
   group_by(microhomology_length) %>%
   filter(n_distinct(ID)>10)%>%
   ungroup() %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = relative_pos, y = ID, color = diff))+
   geom_point()+
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral")+
   facet_wrap(~microhomology_length, scales = "free", ncol = 2)+
   theme_bw()+
   theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
ins_primary_mapping <- fread("output/OVCAR8/ins_read_name_primary_map.tsv", col.names = c("read_id",  "flag", "rname", "pos", "cigar")) %>%
  mutate(strand = if_else(flag %in% c(16, 2064), "-", "+")) %>%

  mutate(poses = process_cigar_positions(strand, as.numeric(pos), cigar)) %>%
  separate(poses, into = c("ref_start", "ref_end", "read_start", "read_end")) %>%
  mutate(ref_start = as.numeric(ref_start), ref_end = as.numeric(ref_end),
         read_start = as.numeric(read_start), read_end = as.numeric(read_end)) %>%

ins_supporting_reads <- ins_primary_mapping %>%

            by =join_by(read_id == read_id, read_start <= forward_read_position, read_end >= forward_read_position)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(chrom = rname, ref_strand = strand) %>%
  filter(!is.na(forward_read_position) ) %>%
  mutate(ref_start = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_end, ref_start)) %>%
  left_join(read_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, ID) %>%
              left_join(sv_merged %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, SV_start)) %>%
              distinct()) 
ins_shift = setDT(ins_supporting_reads %>%
                    filter(ref_position== -1))

ins_shift[, shift_position := deduce_ref_pos_ins_shift(cigar, ref_start, forward_read_position, ref_strand, SV_start)]


INS <- sv_merged %>%

INS_reads <- INS %>%

              dplyr::select(ID, read_id, read_alt_pos, read_strand, read_type)) %>%

merged_INS_reads <- INS_reads %>%
  mutate(mod = case_when(mod_qual >= 0.6 ~ 1,
                         mod_qual <= 0.4 ~ 0,

  left_join(ins_shift %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, forward_read_position, ID, shift_position)) %>%
  mutate(shift_position = case_when(ref_position != -1 & ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position,
                                    ref_position != -1 & ref_position > SV_start ~ ref_position+ SV_len,
                                    T ~ shift_position),
         shift_position = if_else(ref_position == -1 & ref_strand == "-", shift_position +SV_len, shift_position  )) %>%
  filter(abs(SV_start -ref_position) <=2000 | ref_position == -1, !is.na(shift_position)) %>%

  filter(n_distinct(shift_position)>2,
         n_distinct(read_id)>2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)== 2) %>%
  ungroup()
  

  
merged_INS_reads %>%
  filter(base_qual >=20, !is.na(mod) ) %>%
  filter(abs(SV_start -ref_position) <=2000 | ref_position == -1, !is.na(shift_position)) %>%
```

```{r}
         read_start = as.numeric(read_start), read_end = as.numeric(read_end)) %>%

bnd_saf_mapping <- fread("output/OVCAR8/bnd_read_name_saz_map.tsv", col.names = c("read_id", "saz_tag")) %>%
  mutate(saz_tag = gsub("SA:Z:", "", saz_tag)) %>%
  separate_rows(saz_tag, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(saz_tag != "") %>%
  separate(saz_tag, into = c("rname", "pos", "strand", "cigar", "MAPQ", "NM"), sep = ",") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(poses = process_cigar_positions(strand, as.numeric(pos), cigar)) %>%
  separate(poses, into = c("ref_start", "ref_end", "read_start", "read_end")) %>%
  mutate(ref_start = as.numeric(ref_start), ref_end = as.numeric(ref_end),
         read_start = as.numeric(read_start), read_end = as.numeric(read_end)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(pos, MAPQ, NM))%>%
  left_join(bnd_primary_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, ref_start_primary = ref_start, ref_end_primary = ref_end, strand , rname), 
            by= join_by(rname == rname, strand == strand, read_id == read_id, ref_start <=ref_end_primary, ref_end >= ref_start_primary)) %>%
  filter(is.na(ref_end_primary)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ref_start_primary, -ref_end_primary)

BND_supporting_reads <- rbind(bnd_saf_mapping, bnd_primary_mapping) %>%
  left_join(modkit_extract %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, forward_read_position, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual) %>%
              distinct(),
            by =join_by(read_id == read_id, read_start <= forward_read_position, read_end >= forward_read_position)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(chrom = rname, ref_strand = strand) %>%
  filter(!is.na(forward_read_position) ) %>%
  mutate(ref_start = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_end, ref_start))

BND_supporting_reads = setDT(BND_supporting_reads)
BND_supporting_reads[, ref_position := deduce_reference_position(cigar, ref_start, forward_read_position, ref_strand)]

BND_supporting_reads <-BND_supporting_reads %>%

BND_ref_reads  <- modkit_extract %>%
```

```{r}
sv %>%
  left_join(supporting_read) %>%
  pull(read_id) %>%

  write_lines(., "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/OVCAR8/nanomonsv_supporting_read_id.tsv")

  filter(mod_code == "m")

supplementary_read_matrix <- sv %>%
  filter(SV_type == "BND") %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_type, TR, VR, SV_start, SV_end) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(supporting_read %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, read_id, q_alt_start)) %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(ID) ==1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(supplementary_read_bnd %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod_qual, base_qual)) %>%
  mutate(forward_read_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", forward_read_position-1, forward_read_position),
         ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-"& ref_position != -1, ref_position -1, ref_position),
         relative_pos = forward_read_position - q_alt_start)%>%
  filter(abs(relative_pos)< 1000, base_qual >=20 )%>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_id)>=3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(read_type = "alt")

primary_read_matrix <- supplementary_read_matrix  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(OVCAR8_nanomonsv_meth %>%
              filter(! read_id %in% unique(supplementary_read_matrix$read_id), SV_type == "BND") %>%
              filter(ref_position != -1) %>%
              mutate(relative_pos = ref_position -SV_start)) %>%
              dplyr::select(all_of(colnames(supplementary_read_matrix))) %>%
  mutate(read_type = "ref")%>%
  filter(abs(relative_pos)< 1000, base_qual >=20 )
```
